import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Pointwise

open Set
open Pointwise

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {s : Set G}

namespace Subgroup

@[to_additive]
lemma test_closure_pow_le : ∀ {n}, closure (s ^ n) ≤ closure s
  | 0 => by simpa [pow_zero]
  | n + 1 =>
    calc
      closure (s ^ (n + 1))
      _ = closure (s ^ n * s) := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ closure (s ^ n) ⊔ closure s := closure_mul_le ..
      _ ≤ closure s ⊔ closure s := by gcongr ?_ ⊔ _; exact test_closure_pow_le
      _ = closure s := sup_idem _

end Subgroup
